prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a low-speed head-on collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1267; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The front bumper cover is cracked across the center and the upper radiator support is bent, with the hood latch and both headlamp brackets displaced. The crush pattern and paint transfer on the bumper line up with a frontal strike of this kind, and nothing I found points to older damage on this vehicle. The shop's plan is to replace the bumper cover, radiator support, latch and both brackets, then realign and refinish the front end. The labor hours on the estimate run a bit above what I would expect for this scope, so I have asked the shop to justify several line items before final approval. The invoices submitted so far do not show any duplicate charges.
